quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE teams with NVIDIA to bring secure, governed agentic AI (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE plans to support NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs across the portfolio of HPE servers, AI rack-scale systems, HPE Private Cloud AI, HPE AI Factory at-scale and HPE Sovereign AI Factory, with availability based on product lead times; NVIDIA Sentry (out-of-band agent monitoring and policy enforcement) runs on BlueField-4 DPUs using NVIDIA DOCA.
quarterly_data.figure: NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU support planned across HPE servers and AI rack-scale systems

quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE teams with NVIDIA to bring secure, governed agentic AI (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE says the NVIDIA OpenShell secure agent runtime and agentic sandboxes run on NVIDIA Vera CPU systems, including the HPE ProLiant Compute DL394 Gen12, as well as other compute platforms.
quarterly_data.figure: HPE ProLiant Compute DL394 Gen12 (NVIDIA Vera CPU system)

quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE teams with NVIDIA to bring secure, governed agentic AI (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE Private Cloud AI (a turnkey AI factory in the HPE AI Factory with NVIDIA portfolio) is integrating NVIDIA OpenShell, now generally available, with availability planned for Q4 2026; HPE is also integrating NVIDIA Confidential Computing with HPE AI Factory solutions through HPE Services, availability planned for Q4 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: OpenShell in HPE Private Cloud AI and NVIDIA Confidential Computing via HPE Services: availability planned for Q4 2026
